featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked away in Virar, Midnight Express is a true gem for Chinese food lovers. This is not your average fast-food joint; it's a place where the food takes center stage, and every dish is a testament to authentic flavors and quality ingredients. From the moment the food arrives, the rich aromas and vibrant colors promise a memorable experience. We were especially impressed with the fiery Szechuan chicken and perfectly seasoned noodles, both of which delivered a fantastic punch of flavor. The portions are notably generous, ensuring you get excellent value for your money.
​However, the experience is best suited for those with time on their hands. The dine-in service operates at a very relaxed speed. It took a while to get our order taken and even longer for the food to arrive. While the wait can be frustrating if you're in a hurry, the staff were friendly and apologetic for the delays, which helped to temper our frustration. It's clear they are doing their best, and the slow pace seems to be a part of the overall flow rather than a sign of inattentiveness.
​Ultimately, dining at Midnight Express is a trade-off: you sacrifice speed for truly exceptional food. If you’re planning a leisurely dinner and are happy to wait for a great meal, you'll be more than satisfied. If you're on a tight schedule, their delivery service might be a better option.
